# Vendored WebP encoder

Non-SIMD libwebp WASM encoder from jSquash, revision
`da47a2be3b302beb5a5ae164a2ab7aa21a041d90`.
Source: https://github.com/jamsinclair/jSquash/tree/da47a2be3b302beb5a5ae164a2ab7aa21a041d90/packages/webp

Only loaded inside the admin conversion worker; no CDN or external image service.
Upstream licenses are included. AZO uses lossless=1, near_lossless=100, exact=1.
